# DeepLinkNow vs LinkTrace

Install attribution and referral links over REST. As of October 2026, with a public source for every claim.

LinkTrace is a REST API for install attribution and referral links, so there's no SDK to add, which is appealing if you're SDK-averse. The trade-off is that it matches on fingerprints alone, and Universal Links and App Links only come on its top plan, on a linktrace.in subdomain.

| | DeepLinkNow | LinkTrace | Stronger | Sources |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Free plan | Free for up to 25,000 monthly active users, deferred deep links included, and you don't need a card to start | 100 links and 1,000 attributed installs, once (the paid plans reset monthly) | DeepLinkNow | [1] |
| Paid plans | Published on the site: $0, $49, $149 or $499 a month, paid monthly or yearly, and Enterprise from $500 a month | Growth $9.99/mo (1,000 links, 10,000 installs), Scale $29.99/mo (unlimited) | Level | [1] |
| Plan with a custom domain | $49/mo (Startup) | There isn't one. Its top plan, Scale ($29.99/mo), puts Universal Links on a yourbrand.linktrace.in subdomain. | DeepLinkNow | [1] [2] |
| Universal Links and App Links | Every plan, on yourapp.deeplinknow.com or your own domain | Scale only, on a yourbrand.linktrace.in subdomain | DeepLinkNow | [1] [2] |
| Deferred matching | The link page copies the link before the App Store opens and the SDK reads it on first launch, with a scored match as the backup | Fingerprints only, for 24 hours, with no install referrer, and the result is a plain attributed true or false | DeepLinkNow | [2] |
| SDK | iOS, Android, React Native (with Expo) and a Flutter SDK (pub.dev `deeplinknow`) | There's no SDK, just a REST API with copy-paste examples | DeepLinkNow | [3] |
| Advertising IDs | The SDKs never read them, so there's no ATT prompt | Not used | Level | [2] |

## Where DeepLinkNow is ahead

- iOS clipboard handoff on every plan: the link page copies the link and the SDK reads it on first launch.
- Native iOS (Swift) and Android (Kotlin) SDKs, a Flutter SDK (pub.dev `deeplinknow`), a React Native SDK with an Expo config plugin, an Expo Router helper and a useDeferredDeepLink() hook, and an MCP server so coding agents can set it up.
- A free plan for up to 25,000 monthly active users, deferred deep links included, and you don't need a card to start.
- Every fingerprint match comes back with a 0 to 100 score and a HIGH, MEDIUM or LOW label, so you decide what to trust.
- Any path on your link domain is already a link, with no prefix and nothing to create first.
- Hosted in Sydney (Vercel syd1, database in AWS ap-southeast-2), if that matters to your users or your lawyers.

## Pick LinkTrace if…

- You don't want an SDK in the app, and fingerprint matching alone is enough.
- You want referral tracking with referrer IDs over a REST API.

Sources: [3] [1] [2]

If you want the install referrer on Android and the clipboard on iOS, which are exact when they work, try mine.

## The pricing math

LinkTrace bills flat per plan on links and attributed installs: $9.99 for 10,000 installs a month, $29.99 unlimited. I bill on monthly active users. [1]

LinkTrace has no plan with your own domain: Universal Links and App Links need Scale, and even there they run on yourbrand.linktrace.in. On DeepLinkNow, Universal Links work on yourapp.deeplinknow.com on every plan, and your own domain is $49 on Startup. An app with 20,000 monthly users is free, with no one-time cap on installs.

## Switching from LinkTrace

1. Add the DLN SDK next to the one you have and ship it.
2. Point your link domain at DLN. Paths on it work straight away.
3. Read the link with checkDeferredDeepLink() on first launch.
4. Remove the LinkTrace SDK once the links you've already shared stop getting clicks.

## Questions

### How does LinkTrace's pricing compare with DeepLinkNow's?

LinkTrace bills flat per plan on links and attributed installs: $9.99 for 10,000 installs a month, $29.99 unlimited. I bill on monthly active users. LinkTrace has no plan with your own domain: Universal Links and App Links need Scale, and even there they run on yourbrand.linktrace.in. On DeepLinkNow, Universal Links work on yourapp.deeplinknow.com on every plan, and your own domain is $49 on Startup. An app with 20,000 monthly users is free, with no one-time cap on installs.

### When is LinkTrace the better choice?

You don't want an SDK in the app, and fingerprint matching alone is enough. You want referral tracking with referrer IDs over a REST API.

### Can I run DeepLinkNow next to LinkTrace?

Yes. The SDK doesn't depend on any other deep linking SDK, so you can ship both, move your link domain over, and remove the old one later.

App platform with an AppLink deep linking module. As of October 2026, with a public source for every claim.

AppsOnAir sells CodePush, app distribution and push, and AppLink is its deep linking module. It has a real Firebase importer that reads Google Takeout exports. There's no AppLink on the free plan, and the custom domain is an add-on.

| | DeepLinkNow | AppsOnAir | Stronger | Sources |

| What the app gets | A confidence score from 0 to 100 with a HIGH, MEDIUM or LOW label, and you pick the threshold | Organic or non-organic, with no score | DeepLinkNow | [2] |
| Firebase links | Imports your Google Takeout export, so old short links keep their targets, and FDL-style long links on your domain hand the app the link parameter | Imports Google Takeout CSV exports of your Firebase links | Level | [3] |

# DeepLinkNow vs URLgenius

SDK-free app linking. As of October 2026, with a public source for every claim.

URLgenius works differently from everything else here. There's no SDK: it opens apps through URL schemes, and a lot of its customers link into other companies' apps, like Amazon listings, which it's good at. Deferred deep linking is only on its Custom plan.

| | DeepLinkNow | URLgenius | Stronger | Sources |
|---|---|---|---|---|

| What you pay for | Monthly active users (devices that open your app with the SDK). Each distinct link path counts once toward the link limit (1,000 on the free plan). | Clicks: $0.02 each on Growth, with discounts after 10,000 | DeepLinkNow | [1] |
| Plan with a custom domain | $49/mo (Startup) | $49/mo and $0.02 a click (Growth), with no deferred deep links. Deferred links need Custom, from $199/mo. | DeepLinkNow | [1] |
| How links open the app | Universal Links and App Links, with the AASA and assetlinks files hosted for you | URL schemes rather than Universal Links, so every screen you link to needs a URL scheme | DeepLinkNow | [2] |
| API | Management API on Startup and up | Enterprise plans | DeepLinkNow | [2] |

## Where DeepLinkNow is ahead

- A free plan for up to 25,000 monthly active users, deferred deep links included, and you don't need a card to start.
- Published prices: $0, $49, $149 or $499 a month. You only talk to me if you want Enterprise.
- Any path on your link domain is already a link, with no prefix and nothing to create first.

- You can't ship an app update or add an SDK.
